Got it — updated plan, one story only:

1. Shell: single floor, back + side walls, front open for the cutaway.
2. Hero cubicle: beige partitions, desk, CRT, PC tower, phone, filing cabinet.
3. Damage: blown hole, cracked wall, fallen tiles, debris, one partition askew, scorch marks.
4. Dressing: carpet, fluorescent tube, papers, broken chair.

No exterior built at all — through the blown hole, leave it plain, no detail needed. Built in Geppetto only.

Say “build it” when you want me to start it in Build mode.
